judged_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/decodeOAuthState.ts:9 — `const state: IntegrationOAuthCallbackState = JSON.parse(req.query.state);` trusts provider-round-tripped state without a server-generated nonce, signature, or session comparison, so an attacker can send their own authorization code to a logged-in victim’s callback and bind attacker-controlled OAuth credentials to the victim account (rebuttal gate: safe only if every provider independently binds this value to the victim’s Cal.com session, which the consuming callbacks do not verify).
